set.body:
Outcome
Consume and verify the provider contract; do not duplicate provider implementation in this repository.

Owned scope
provider pin; meridian-scaladock consumer fixture; docs/evidence/provider-acceptance

Prerequisites
A1

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Read the ScalaDock provider epic @S@ in ../scaladock; obtain its reviewed full commit, floor/27 evidence and API notes. Keep this issue blocked until an actual candidate is available.
- [ ] Pin that candidate explicitly and execute a JavaFX 27 consumer probe for custom scheme, live metrics, popup policy, keyboard actions, motion and pane identity.
- [ ] Prove default dependency resolution does not silently use ../scaladock; changing the configured pin changes the tested candidate and is recorded.
- [ ] Record exact provider/consumer SHAs or artifact digests, runtime graph, commands/exits and limitations; only a passing consumer receipt unblocks B1.

Required evidence
Executable consumer receipt; provider S6 review is required evidence, not a substitute for this consumer run.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code B0. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [B0] Accept the ScalaDock provider candidate on JavaFX 27
